seo.title: 34 Essential Tools for Web3 Frontend Developers
seo.description: A curated list of tools for Web3 frontend developers covering wallet connections, state management, UI components, and dApp development.

content.intro: Building Web3 frontends requires specialized tools for wallet connections, blockchain interactions, and handling the unique UX challenges of decentralized applications. Here are the essential tools.

sections.heading: Wallet Connection
sections.description: Libraries for connecting to user wallets.

items.name: wagmi
items.description: React hooks library for Ethereum. The standard for Web3 React development with excellent TypeScript support.

items.name: RainbowKit
items.description: Beautiful, easy-to-use wallet connection modal. Built on wagmi with great design.

items.name: ConnectKit
items.description: Alternative to RainbowKit with more customization options. Also built on wagmi.

items.name: Web3Modal
items.description: WalletConnect's official modal. Supports most wallets and chains.

items.name: Privy
items.description: Embedded wallet and authentication. Great for onboarding non-crypto users.

items.name: Dynamic
items.description: Multi-chain authentication with embedded wallets and social login options.

sections.heading: Blockchain Interaction
sections.description: Libraries for reading and writing to blockchains.

items.name: viem
items.description: TypeScript interface for Ethereum. Fast, modular, and type-safe. The modern choice.

items.name: ethers.js
items.description: Mature Ethereum library. Large ecosystem and extensive documentation.

items.name: Alchemy SDK
items.description: Enhanced APIs for NFTs, tokens, and transactions. Built on top of ethers/viem.

items.name: thirdweb SDK
items.description: All-in-one SDK for Web3 development with pre-built contracts and UI components.

sections.heading: State Management
sections.description: Tools for managing blockchain state in your app.

items.name: TanStack Query
items.description: Data fetching library that pairs perfectly with wagmi for caching blockchain data.

items.name: Zustand
items.description: Lightweight state management. Great for dApp-specific state alongside wagmi.

items.name: Jotai
items.description: Atomic state management. Works well for complex dApp state. Free and open-source.

items.name: shadcn/ui
items.description: Beautiful, accessible components built on Radix. Copy-paste into your project.

items.name: Radix UI
items.description: Unstyled, accessible component primitives. Foundation for many Web3 UIs.

items.name: Chakra UI
items.description: Accessible component library with good theming. Popular in Web3.

items.name: daisyUI
items.description: Tailwind CSS component library. Quick styling for dApps. Free and open-source.

sections.heading: Data and APIs
sections.description: Services for blockchain data and RPC.

items.name: Alchemy
items.description: Leading blockchain infrastructure. Reliable RPC with enhanced APIs.

items.name: Infura
items.description: Ethereum and IPFS infrastructure from ConsenSys. Mature and reliable.

items.name: QuickNode
items.description: Multi-chain RPC provider with good performance. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: The Graph
items.description: Decentralized indexing. Query blockchain data with GraphQL. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Moralis
items.description: Web3 APIs for tokens, NFTs, and wallets. Quick integration. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: CoinGecko API
items.description: Price data for tokens. Essential for portfolio displays. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: ENS.js
items.description: Library for ENS resolution and management. Check the GitHub repo for documentation and examples.

items.name: Effigy
items.description: Ethereum avatar service. Display ENS avatars easily. Free and open-source.

items.name: Ethereum Blockies
items.description: Generate blockie identicons for addresses without ENS. Free and open-source. Active open-source project on GitHub.

items.name: Anvil
items.description: Local Ethereum node from Foundry. Perfect for frontend testing.

items.name: Synpress
items.description: E2E testing with MetaMask support. Test real wallet interactions.

items.name: Playwright
items.description: Browser automation. Can be combined with Synpress for wallet testing.

items.name: Storybook
items.description: Component development environment. Great for building Web3 UI components in isolation.

items.name: Etherscan APIs
items.description: Contract verification, ABI fetching, and transaction data. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Sourcify
items.description: Decentralized contract verification. Alternative to Etherscan verification.

items.name: useHooks
items.description: Collection of React hooks including Web3-useful ones. Free and open-source.

items.name: date-fns
items.description: Date utility library. Essential for displaying timestamps from blocks.

proTips.tip: Use wagmi + viem as your foundation. They're the most modern and well-maintained options.
Always handle loading, error, and disconnected states explicitly. Web3 has many failure modes.
Test with real wallets on testnets, not just mocks. MetaMask behaves differently than test mocks.
Cache RPC calls aggressively. Users on slow connections and RPC rate limits will thank you.
Build mobile-first. Many users access dApps through mobile wallet browsers.
